_comment: Pin for the BtbN FFmpeg Windows x64 LGPL STATIC build fetched by fetch.ps1.
Pinned against the autobuild-2026-08-02-13-17 checksums.sha256 and a local download SHA-256.
1. Open https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases and pick a DATED release tag
(e.g. autobuild-YYYY-MM-DD-...). NEVER use the 'latest' rolling tag or any
ffmpeg-master-latest-* asset — those change under the same URL.
2. Choose the win64 *lgpl* NON-shared asset for a release branch, e.g.:
('lgpl' = static single-exe build; NOT 'gpl', NOT 'nonfree', NOT 'lgpl-shared').
3. Set 'url' to that asset's download URL, 'version' to the ffmpeg version string
4. Download once, compute SHA-256 (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256), cross-check with
the checksums file on the same BtbN release if present, and set 'sha256'.
5. In 'source_url', record where the corresponding SOURCE archives live (BtbN
publishes source tarballs alongside builds) — required for LGPL compliance,
fetch.ps1 refuses to run while sha256 starts with 'REPLACE_ME'.
